How to Submit to the Phygital+ AI Library (Submitator teardown)

requirements: AI tools aimed at graphics/design/art/creative work; run by the Phygital+ (PHYGITALISM Inc.) team
No account and no fee: the submission page is a ~3-field form that posts to an Airtable base
No name or email is collected by the form per the third-party teardown
preparation: Tool name, URL, and description (three text boxes per the teardown)
Expect no confirmation email - the form shows only an on-page thank-you
workflow: Open https://library.phygital.plus/tool-submission/ in a real browser (JS-rendered; empty to plain fetch)
Fill the three text boxes and press Send
On-page thank-you appears; there is no further notification
watchFor: Freshness doubt: third-party analysis dated the newest third-party tool entry around Feb 2025 - the library may be barely maintained
Outbound links on entries are inserted by JavaScript (not in server HTML), so crawler credit for the link is uncertain even though no nofollow was observed
Do not confuse with phygital.plus accounts; no login is needed here
Some third-party listings claim 'account required' or 'nofollow' - the detailed teardown contradicts both; treat those claims as wrong
countsAsLive: A new entry page exists in the library under library.phygital.plus and links out to the submitted tool.
